description: This file contains atomic operation definitions and inline implementations for 32-bit and 64-bit atomic operations, used internally in jemalloc for thread-safe atomic manipulations.

methods.name: atomic_add_uint64
methods.description: Performs an atomic addition on a 64-bit unsigned integer, with platform-specific implementations.

methods.name: atomic_sub_uint64
methods.description: Performs an atomic subtraction on a 64-bit unsigned integer, with platform-specific implementations.

methods.name: atomic_add_uint32
methods.description: Performs an atomic addition on a 32-bit unsigned integer, with platform-specific implementations.

methods.name: atomic_sub_uint32
methods.description: Performs an atomic subtraction on a 32-bit unsigned integer, with platform-specific implementations.

methods.name: atomic_add_z
methods.description: Performs an atomic addition on size_t, choosing 64-bit or 32-bit implementation based on pointer size.

methods.name: atomic_sub_z
methods.description: Performs an atomic subtraction on size_t, choosing 64-bit or 32-bit implementation based on pointer size.

methods.name: atomic_add_u
methods.description: Performs an atomic addition on unsigned int, choosing 64-bit or 32-bit implementation based on int size.

methods.name: atomic_sub_u
methods.description: Performs an atomic subtraction on unsigned int, choosing 64-bit or 32-bit implementation based on int size.
